Which statement about elements in the Periodic Table is correct?
A potassium ion, K+, has the same electronic configuration as a chloride ion, Cl–.
A
The electronic configuration of a Ca2+ ion is 2,8,8,2.
B
C
The halogens are in Group VI and so their atoms have six electrons in their outer shell.
Magnesium is in Period 3 and so a magnesium ion, Mg2+, has three occupied electron shells.
D
